transitionalWaiver.reason: v2026.1023.0 predates the managed Codex project-auth implementation. Porting the deployed patch stack to that tag would require a substantive rewrite with no operational benefit.
transitionalWaiver.replaceWith: The first stable tag that contains the managed Codex project-auth patch stack

patches.retireWhen: The stable base contains all five commits or patch-equivalent changes.
patches.notes: Scopes managed Codex project-auth checks to the task project and uses the Harness project-auth policy for routed accounts. The deploy commits were produced on canary.7; the upstream PR was rebased onto canary.8 on 2026-10-24. Both stacks have the same patch IDs.

patches.retireWhen: The accepted stable base contains the macOS remote process identity fix and signal ownership checks or patch-equivalent changes.
patches.notes: Adds Darwin boot/start process evidence and portable timestamps. Stop and failed-launch cleanup verify live ownership, including before KILL escalation. The upstream and deployment commits have matching patch IDs.

patches.retireWhen: The accepted stable base distinguishes isolated Claude user settings from project authentication with equivalent local and shell-backed remote coverage.
patches.notes: Deployment-specific conservative boundary: reject project authentication from the physical task directory through ancestors below the host home. Managed CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR replaces the host user settings. Retain this small port while upstream Claude settings-source discovery evolves.

patches.retireWhen: The accepted stable base contains the five portable test baseline commits or patch-equivalent changes.
patches.notes: Test-only portability fixes for native Git diagnostics, npm pack metadata, loaded fixture waits, uninstall host-home isolation, and macOS TCP admission. The deploy and upstream stacks have matching patch IDs. The full local baseline completed with 42662 tests passed, 158 existing conditional skips, and zero final failures after full-scope repairs. No new skip or waiver was added.
